56	def _to_gemini_parts(content: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
57	    """Translate a user message's content into Gemini ``parts``.
58	
59	    A string becomes a single text part (unchanged behavior). A multimodal list has each
60	    part translated: text -> ``{"text": ...}``, ``image_url`` base64 data URL ->
61	    ``{"inlineData": {"mimeType": ..., "data": ...}}``. Non-base64 image URLs fall back to
62	    a text note since the judge image tool only ever emits base64 data URLs. Any other part
63	    type is passed through unchanged rather than coerced to empty text, so a non-text part
64	    (e.g. ``input_audio``) isn't silently dropped.
65	    """
66	    if not isinstance(content, list):
67	        return [{"text": content}]
68	
69	    parts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
70	    for part in content:
71	        if part.get("type") == "text":
72	            parts.append({"text": part.get("text", "")})
73	        elif part.get("type") == "image_url":
74	            url = part.get("image_url", {}).get("url", "")
75	            if parsed := parse_base64_data_url(url):
76	                mime, data = parsed
77	                parts.append({"inlineData": {"mimeType": mime, "data": data}})
78	            else:
79	                parts.append({"text": f"[unsupported image reference: {url}]"})
80	        else:
81	            parts.append(part)
82	    return parts

85	def _tool_result_to_response(content: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
86	    """Coerce OpenAI tool message content into a Gemini ``functionResponse.response``.
87	
88	    OpenAI tool content is free-form and usually plain text, but Gemini requires an object,
89	    so a JSON object passes through and anything else is wrapped as ``{"result": ...}``.
90	    """
91	    try:
92	        parsed = json.loads(content)
93	    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
94	        return {"result": content}
95	    return parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {"result": parsed}

99	    """Translate an OpenAI ``tool_choice`` into a Gemini ``functionCallingConfig``.
100	
101	    Returns None for an omitted or ``"auto"`` choice so Gemini keeps its default (AUTO) mode.

289	    @classmethod
290	    def _convert_function_call_to_openai_choice(
291	        cls,
292	        content_parts: list[dict[str, Any]],
293	        finish_reason: str,
294	        choice_idx: int,
295	        stream: bool,
296	    ):
297	        # convert gemini model responded "function call" struct to Openai choice / choice chunk
298	        # struct.
299	        # Gemini doc: https://ai.google.dev/api/caching#FunctionCall
300	
301	        # A candidate can mix text and functionCall parts in any order, e.g. a short
302	        # "Let me look that up." followed by the call. Keep both.
303	        tool_calls = []
304	        text_parts = []
305	        for part in content_parts:
306	            if "text" in part:
307	                text_parts.append(part["text"])
308	            function_call = part.get("functionCall")
309	            if not function_call:
310	                continue
311	            func_name = function_call["name"]
312	            func_arguments = json.dumps(function_call["args"])
313	            call_id = function_call.get("id")
314	            # Gemini 3.x places thoughtSignature at the Part level, next to functionCall.
315	            # Some older responses nested it inside functionCall instead, so fall back to
316	            # that location too.
317	            thought_sig = (
318	                part.get("thoughtSignature")
319	                or part.get("thought_signature")
320	                or function_call.get("thoughtSignature")
321	                or function_call.get("thought_signature")
322	            )
323	            if call_id is None:
324	                # Gemini model response might not contain function call id,
325	                # in order to make it compatible with Openai chat protocol,
326	                # we need to generate a unique call id.
327	                call_id = (
328	                    "call_"
329	                    + hashlib.md5(
330	                        f"{func_name}/{func_arguments}".encode(),
331	                        usedforsecurity=False,
332	                    ).hexdigest()
333	                )
334	            if stream:
335	                tool_calls.append(
336	                    chat_schema.ToolCallDelta(
337	                        index=0,
338	                        id=call_id,
339	                        function=Function(
340	                            name=func_name,
341	                            arguments=func_arguments,
342	                        ),
343	                        type="function",
344	                        thought_signature=thought_sig,
345	                    )
346	                )
347	            else:
348	                tool_calls.append(
349	                    ToolCall(
350	                        id=call_id,
351	                        function=Function(
352	                            name=func_name,
353	                            arguments=func_arguments,
354	                        ),
355	                        type="function",
356	                        thought_signature=thought_sig,
357	                    )
358	                )
359	        content = "".join(text_parts) or None
360	        if stream:
361	            return chat_schema.StreamChoice(
362	                index=choice_idx,
363	                delta=chat_schema.StreamDelta(
364	                    role="assistant",
365	                    content=content,
366	                    tool_calls=tool_calls,
367	                ),
368	                finish_reason=finish_reason,
369	            )
370	        return chat_schema.Choice(
371	            index=choice_idx,
372	            message=chat_schema.ResponseMessage(
373	                role="assistant",
374	                content=content,
375	                tool_calls=tool_calls,
376	            ),
377	            finish_reason=finish_reason,
378	        )
